messages:
Anya K: FYI — Acme pilot ops just asked if we can *include per-tenant embedding sync* in the MVP. They said it's a gating ask for their pilot.
Devin R: Oof. That was scoped for v1. Adding embeddings sync touches infra + storage + telemetry.
Samir P: How firm is the ask? Can we ship pilot without it and roll a feature flag later?
Anya K: Sales said 'must have' unless we give a 2-week concession on start date. Pilot is revenue-significant.
Mira L: Two-week slip buys us room but impacts other customers waiting for the rollout window.
Samir P: Technical quick gut: MVP without durable sync -> we can do ephemeral in-memory cache + manual refresh API. Not ideal but lower effort.
Devin R: Ephemeral will break their multi-tenant consistency expectations. Also complicates measurements in the Console.
Anya K: Proposal: offer a breathing-room trade — delay pilot by 10 business days OR ship with an EMS (engineering-managed sync) runbook (manual refresh) + SLA caveat.
Mira L: If we pick manual refresh, we need acceptance criteria: docs for runbook, a toggle in Console, and a regression test in our evals.
Samir P: Add a mitigation: if manual runs > X failures in 24h, auto-fallback to hosted embeddings variant and notify them + SE.
Devin R: Timeline impact: manual-run option ~3 dev days + 2 QA days. Full per-tenant durable sync ~3 sprints. Numbers seem clear.
Anya K: Can eng sign off on the manual-run approach tomorrow? We need wording for the customer (sales wants copy).
Samir P: I can draft the technical caveat. Quick ask: PM, can you confirm which telemetry/metrics Acme needs for pilot success (e.g., sync latency, items/sec)?
Anya K: Confirming — they care about sync latency < 2 min and no data loss. I'll ask Sales for exact SLOs.
Mira L: If they insist on strict SLOs, we push for the 2-week slip. Otherwise accept manual run + documented constraints.
Anya K: Action items:
- Anya: get SLOs from Sales by EOD. (4370001400)
- Samir: draft runbook + fallback policy by EOD. (4370001600)
- Devin: quick QA checklist for manual sync on Console (4370001700)
- Mira: prepare customer-facing concession text and timeline options (4370001750)
pm-bot: Reminder — please update the pilot milestone card with chosen option and owners.
Samir P: Drafting runbook now. If Sales wants faster cadence, we can also offer a 'pilot-lite' where embeddings are proxied via hosted model for the pilot period.
Anya K: Thanks. I'll push for the slip but prepare the manual-run text as fallback. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: scope negotiation and milestone tracking; short Slack thread style
